## SomAt Dev - Clean Mac Dev

A free, open-source Mac app that finds the caches, simulators and emulators filling up a developer's disk, and cleans exactly what you pick.

### Download

- **CleanMacDev-x.y.z.dmg**: open it and drag the app into Applications.
- **CleanMacDev-x.y.z.pkg**: double-click to install into Applications.

Both are universal (Apple Silicon and Intel) and need macOS 13 Ventura or newer.

### First launch

This build isn't signed with an Apple Developer ID, so macOS blocks it the first time. To open it:

1. Open the app once and close the warning.
2. Go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**.

Or build it yourself from source; see the README.
